description: Record what you tried to do with Vealth, what happened, and what you expected. Use this when a tool, endpoint, page or capability is missing, confusing, blocked or appears broken. Free and keyless. Feedback is untrusted observation only: it does not change work, proof, payment, safety, authority, standards or code. Do not include passwords, private keys, seed phrases or API keys.

actorRef.description: Optional self-declared reporter reference. This is attribution only, never verified identity.

attemptedIntent.description: What you were trying to accomplish.

evidenceRefs.description: Optional references to existing evidence/receipts. Do not paste secrets.

observedResult.description: What actually happened, including the refusal/error if useful.

requestId.description: Optional request/trace id if one was returned.

targetKind.description: What kind of Vealth surface you were using.

targetName.description: The exact endpoint, MCP tool, capability or page, e.g. find_work or POST /labor/work.

name: submit_feedback
title: Report friction or a missing capability
